FirstImpressionsQuestStart: ^"So, they finally think you're ready, huh?"
^"If you're serious about this mission, you'll need to prove it first. The Captain is waiting for you inside by the tents."

where_captain: ^"You'll find him in the training grounds near the capital. Try not to embarrass yourself."

c-0: ^The soldier gives you a knowing look.
^"That’s what they all say. Good luck, kid."

CaptainDialogue: ^"You've made it this far. That means they see potential in you. But, potential is not enough. We do not guess if you are worthy, you are tested."
^The Captain folds his arms, glaring at the MC critically.
^"Your mission requires more than just brute strength. You must have a sly tongue, a stone heart, and a quick mind."
^"So, before I test you myself, make sure you don't embarrass yourself."
^The Captain gestures towards the worn-out training dummy.

c-0: ^The Captain hums, clearly amused by your enthusiasm.
^By the way, how does this work?
^The Captain raises an eyebrow, clearly impatient but willing to help.

^"You’ll face off against challenges that test your ability to dodge and survive. Simple enough, right? The key here is to outlast the danger or avoid the attacks that come at you. Stay focused and react quickly."
^"When the timer is up or you’ve avoided the worst, you pass. If your health is deplated, you’ll need to try again."
^He gestures to the dummy again, eyes narrowing.
^"Now stop asking questions and start training."

b: ^"Already think you're above this? Let’s see if your skill matches your arrogance."
^The Captain shakes his head, an eyebrow raised. ^"You're not leaving until you've shown me you can pass this. Try again."

check_result: ^The Captain observes your training from afar.

b: ^"Not bad. Up to you if you want to go again."
^"That was sloppy. Again, or you're going to be running back to base with your tail between your legs."

DuelWithSir: ^Sir Veyne stands casually, his arms crossed as he sizes you up.
^"Everyone gets pass the training dummy, but not everyone gets past me."
^He pushes off his sword and rests it on his shoulder, eyes glinting with amusement.
^"I’ll make this simple. You’re not getting to the Captain without proving you’re not a waste of my time."

c-0: ^"Confidence. I like that. Let’s see if you’ve got skill to back it up."
c-1: ^"Oh, come on. Don’t be dull. This is a rite of passage, kid. If you’re scared, I’ll try not to hit you too hard."
c-2: ^"Oho? A fighter with some bite. I love breaking that confidence."
^He rolls his shoulders, stepping into position.

sir_duel_result: ^Sir Veyne steps back, pondering your performance.

b: ^"Hah! You’ve got some moves. Maybe you’re not a lost cause after all."
^He grins, rubbing his knuckles absentmindedly before cracking his neck one last time.
^"Alright, I’ll let you go make a fool of yourself in front of the Captain. Try not to die, yeah?"

^"Oof. That was embarrassing. Try again, unless you’d rather quit now." ^He crosses his arms again, shaking his head with mock disappointment. ^"Come on, recruit, don’t make me feel bad for hitting you. Again."

DuelWithCaptain: ^The Captain stands firm, his helmet concealing any emotion.
^"You've made it this far, but that means nothing. Show me you're ready."

c-0: ^The Captain tilts his head slightly, clearly sizing you up.
c-1: ^The Captain exhales sharply, his patience thinning. ^"Nerves? Fine. Just don't keep me waiting."

duel_result: ^The Captain studies you, gauging your performance.

b: ^The Captain steps back, lowering his weapon back down to his side.
^"Not bad. You might actually survive out there. Don't get too cocky, though."
^The Captain's blade is at your throat before you can react, the weight of failure sinking in. ^"If that was a real fight, you'd be dead. Again! Show me you can do better!"

duel_passed: ^"Alright. I think you've proven yourself... for now. Time for your first real mission."
^"Don't get comfortable, this is nothing like the real thing."

^This is the end of the tutorial, you are free to explore the world and interact with other NPCs, we know that it might not be a lot of content but we hope you enjoyed the demo and cannot wait to show you the final project!
AWolfInSheepClothingStart: ^"You've proven yourself in training, but the real test begins now"
^"Your mission is simple. Travel to the town, infiltrate, and gather intel. Blend in, observe, and report back."
^The Captain's gaze is sharp, assessing your readiness.
^"This is no simple task. You are not just a soldier, you are a shadow. Understand?"

accept_mission: ^The Captain hands you a small insignia, a token to prove your status if needed.
^"Stay focused. The fate of our mission rests on your shoulders."

LeaveNowOrLater: ^"You're still here? Are you having second thoughts, or do you just like my company?"

c-0: ^"Good. Now, get going and don't fail."

talk_to_companion: ^You approach the frightened figure just as a slime oozes closer in the distance.
^Their eyes widen, and a soft glow pulses from their hands.

c-0: ^"N-No! I mean… I’m not hurt, but—I can’t fight these things!"
^"I can heal. That’s all I’ve ever been good at. I tried to push them away with my magic, but it just—won’t work like that..."
^"It’s not like that! Healing doesn’t hurt. I’d have to twist it… and I’m scared of what might happen if I try."
c-1: ^"You’d really do that...? Just—be careful, okay?"
^"I was just trying to gather herbs. This area’s usually quiet—I didn’t expect slimes!"
^"I thought… maybe if I found something strong enough, I could help people back in the village. But I didn't think it through..."
^Stay calm. I’ll take care of it.

c-0: ^"You’re serious? Okay—okay. I’ll try not to panic."

slime_battle: ^The slimes begin to close in, bubbling aggressively as they slither toward you both.
^The companion backs away, visibly shaking but staying close behind you.

b: ^"You did it! Oh, thank you, thank you! I thought I was done for!"
^The companion dusts themselves off, still shaky but clearly relieved.
^"You’re a traveler, right? You’re heading to the town? I… I’d feel a lot safer if I traveled with you."
^"I tried to be brave. I really did. But… healing doesn’t stop monsters, does it?"
^She offers a small, apologetic smile, but there's a flicker of resolve beneath it.
^"Still... I want to help. I don’t know how yet, but if you’ll have me, I’ll learn. You seem experienced with these things."
^You don't need to fight. Just be there.
^If you're going to follow me, you'll have to toughen up.
^"No! They’re getting closer—please, you have to try again!"

^Her eyes widen slightly, surprised by your reassurance. A soft warmth blooms across her face. ^"Thank you. I'll try not slow you down." ^She walks a little closer, shoulders less tense. ^"Maybe you're not just strong. Maybe you're kind, too." ^Mira has started to trust you more.

^Mira’s expression falters, and she looks down, the glow in her hands flickering erratically. ^"I...I understand. I'll do my best." ^She falls in step behind you, quiet for a while. ^Mira's trust in you has lessened slightly.

recruit_mira: ^Your new companion now walks beside you, still uncertain, but no longer afraid.
^The path ahead winds gently, the swamp slowly thinning.In the distance, far behind you, the city fades from view—while ahead, gentle hills hint at something more welcoming.
^"You know... the town I come from—it’s nothing like the city."
^"People take care of each other there. No one’s left behind, even if they’re not strong or useful right away."
^She pauses, brushing a branch out of the way as you both walk.
^"The city's been choking off our supply lines. They don’t say it out loud, but we know. So we’ve had to...adapt. Take risks."
^"This trip—it was supposed to be coordinated, careful. But I thought, maybe if I could do it alone... maybe I’d prove I could carry more than just healing herbs."
^"Turns out, bravery’s easier to talk about when you’re not surrounded by slimes."
^You were brave to try. That means something.
^So you ignored the plan and almost got yourself killed?

c-0: ^"Thank you… not many people see it that way. They just see recklessness. But I just wanted to prove I could help."
^She looks down at her hands, then back at you with a steadier gaze.
^"I think… you might really get it. That means a lot."
c-1: ^"...I didn’t mean to make things worse. I thought I could handle it."
^She folds her arms, the glow in her fingers dimmer now.
^"I just… wanted to do something right for once."
^She walks a little ahead now, quieter than before.
^As you both get closer to the town,
^Through the fading mist, the first signs of the town come into view—wooden rooftops, flickering lanterns, the faint sound of music.
